title_sq: Tek Bazaar Gate, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1, Me Planimetri Te Rregullt!!

title_en: At Bazaar Gate, Super Apartment 2+1 for sale, with regular layout!!
description_en: At Bazaar Gate, Super Apartment 2+1 for sale, with regular layout!!! The apartment is located on the 15th floor of a 27-story building. The gross area of ​​the apartment is 103.6 m2, of which the net area is 83.0 m2. It is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchenette, 2 bedrooms, a bathroom and a balcony. The orientation of the property is South, which enables natural lighting during most of the day. Bazaar Gate is located in the center of Tirana, a residential center that offers every possible comfort for living and investment. Currently, the construction is in the pit phase.
